name: Hoco EQ10 Plus Wireless Earbuds – ANC + ENC Noise Reduction, LED Display, 5.4 Bluetooth
description:
Experience crystal-clear sound with the Hoco EQ10 Plus Wireless Earbuds. Featuring advanced ANC (Active Noise Cancellation) and ENC (Environmental Noise Cancellation), these earbuds deliver immersive audio even in noisy environments. With a 13mm large dynamic coil, LED digital display, and Bluetooth 5.4 wireless connectivity, enjoy long-lasting comfort and seamless pairing. Connect two phones at the same time and enjoy up to 7 hours of playtime on a single charge. Perfect for music, calls, and on-the-go lifestyles.
luetooth Version: 5.4
Speaker Size: 13mm
Battery Capacity: 40mAh
Charging Case: 300mAh
Charging Time: About 1 Hour
Usage Time: Up to 7 hours (6 hours with ANC)
Dimensions: 65 x 51.5 x 28.5 mm
